_comment: Runnable (system-1) conformance spec for the scanner P3 read API, the standalone canonical flat form interface_conformance.py executes ({method,path,path_params,query,body,required}). INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md '## Conformance spec' REFERENCES this file (per the iv_rank.json / user-accounts.json standalone convention; system-12) — it is NOT embedded as a nested json block in the contract (that was the ai-recommendations GATE-Z trap). Covers ONLY the two anonymous-open, cookieless-deterministic READS: GET /api/scan (the requested-or-default view — cookieless ⇒ the owner-curated default view, D2) and GET /api/scan/universe (the read-only universe list). The gated WRITE PUT /api/scan/view is EXCLUDED from this anonymous sweep exactly as ai-recommendations' auth-gated POST is: a cookieless probe returns a real 401/403 by design (server-side-gate-enforcement), so it can't be conformance-checked by the cookieless tool — its signed-in echo shape + the gated-401 path are verified by the BE runtime proofs + FE tests. GET /api/scan/view (an anonymous-open read returning the default view) is also anonymous-open but is not added here; these two reads are the representative anonymous surface. What is asserted is ONLY the environment-independent ENVELOPE shape, never a deep row/heartbeat leaf: the scanstore starts EMPTY and the worker may not have written a heartbeat yet, so `rows` can be [] and `sweep` can be null on a fresh boot (best-effort-isolated-or-null). Asserting rows[0].* or a sweep child would FAIL a legitimately-empty/pre-worker cycle. Row-field types/presence (the ScanRow.to_wire keys) + heartbeat fields (SweepHeartbeat.to_wire) + the closed status vocabulary are pinned in INTERFACE_CONTRACT and verified off-harness by the BE runtime proofs + the FE test matrix (UX_BLUEPRINT s6). Boot: npx nx serve api (uvicorn :8000); no ticker warm-up needed (the scan reads are store reads, not a cold vendor fetch). SUPERSEDED IN PART 2026-10-26 (SEC-1, docs/quality/2026-10-25/SITE-AUDIT.md): GET /api/scan is no longer anonymous-open. Its rows carry the flip and the walls, derived from the licensed options feed, which reach a signed-in account only (owner rule 2026-10-18). This cookieless sweep now asserts its 403 auth_required refusal; the signed-in envelope is checked in auth-gated.json. GET /api/scan/universe stays anonymous-open (ticker names only).

endpoints._note: SEC-1 (2026-10-26): cookieless ⇒ the server-side gate refuses with 403 auth_required (the same envelope as /api/book and /api/broker/*). The signed-in default-view envelope moved to auth-gated.json (scan_default_view_signed_in).
The read-only owner-curated universe the view editor selects from. Anonymous-open. universe_size is the count the worker was configured with.
